title: Find the full names of members who attended any 'Meeting' event in 2020 and
question: Find the full names of members who attended any 'Meeting' event in 2020 and whose total approved expenses across all events exceed the average expense cost of all club expenditures.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m."XCL_035", m."XCL_036"
FROM member AS m
WHERE m."XCL_034" IN (
    SELECT a."XCL_002"
    FROM attendance AS a
    INNER JOIN event AS e ON a."XCL_001" = e."XCL_010"
    WHERE e."XCL_013" = 'Meeting'
      AND SUBSTRING(e."XCL_012", 1, 4) = '2020'
)
AND m."XCL_034" IN (
    SELECT ex."XCL_022"
    FROM expense AS ex
    WHERE ex."XCL_021" = 'true'
    GROUP BY ex."XCL_022"
    HAVING SUM(ex."XCL_020") > (SELECT AVG("XCL_020") FROM expense)
)
